parent.description: Config type instance that contains this config child.

maxRetries.description: Number of retries due to rate limiting

initialSleepMillis.description:
Sleep for 3 seconds based on SDK methodology.
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepoint/dev/general-development/how-to-avoid-getting-throttled-or-blocked-in-sharepoint-online
https://github.com/microsoft/kiota-java/blob/1a8be6ec4b47766bf022126b8be6b4d6b5c201d7/components/http/okHttp/src/main/java/com/microsoft/kiota/http/middleware/options/RetryHandlerOption.java#L40

exponent.description: The exponent to multiply the prior wait time in generating the next

maxSleepMillis.description: Maximum wait time allowed for each retry. If <= 0 the default will be used.

maxTotalMillis.description: Maximum wait time allowed for all retry waits

minSleepMillis.description: Sleep for 3 seconds based on SDK methodology.

retryOnEmptyResult.description: If set to true, it will retry when result is empty.

jitter.description: Ensure that wait times are increasing on average

retryAllErrors.description:
If true, all errors will be retried. If false, only retryable errors {@link Retry#shouldRetryLogic}
will be retried.

trace.description:
If true, the retry logic will report each retry attempt in root `C3.action()`'s `#customContext` with key as
`retry-trace`.

enabled.description: @return `true` if this file system is enabled.

readOnlyMounts.description: List of mounts that are read only.

aclEnabledMounts.description:
List of mounts that are ACL enabled. For mounts that are ACL enabled access control is performed by
{@link FileMeta}.

title: MsGraph store based file system configuration.
